title: Penetration Testing Configuration Schema
description: Schema for YAML configuration files used in the penetration testing agent

authentication.description: Authentication configuration for the target application

login_url.description: URL for the login page or endpoint

totp_secret.description: TOTP secret for two-factor authentication (Base32 encoded, case insensitive)

email_login.description: Email account credentials for magic-link or OTP follow-through flows

address.description: Email address used to receive magic links or OTPs

totp_secret.description: TOTP secret for the email account's two-factor authentication (Base32 encoded)

login_flow.description: Step-by-step instructions for the login process

type.description: Type of success condition to check

value.description: Value to match against the success condition

pipeline.description: Pipeline execution settings for retry behavior and concurrency

retry_preset.description: Retry preset. 'subscription' extends timeouts for Anthropic subscription rate limit windows (5h+).

rules.description: Testing rules that define what to focus on or avoid during penetration testing

avoid.description: Rules defining areas to avoid during testing

focus.description: Rules defining areas to focus on during testing

vuln_classes.description: Vulnerability classes to test. When omitted, all five classes run. When set, only listed classes run; their vuln+exploit agents and report sections are included.

exploit.description: Whether to run the exploitation phase (default true). Set false to run only analysis.

report.description: Report filtering and guidance applied by the report agent.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity threshold; findings below are dropped by the report agent.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold; findings below are dropped by the report agent.

guidance.description: Free-text guidance to the report agent (e.g., 'Drop findings about missing security headers').

rules_of_engagement.description: Free-text instructions to the agent that render into every prompt.

code_context.description: Codebase-specific hints (framework, data-access clients, auth/session helpers, known outbound services) injected into the analysis prompts via {{CODE_CONTEXT}}. Keeps target-specific identifiers out of the shared prompt templates.

agent_executors.description: Per-agent executor routing. Maps an agent name to the executor that runs it. Agents not listed fall back to the agent's built-in default, then SHANNON_EXECUTOR, then the global default.

hermes_models.description: Named Hermes model targets ('model types'). Each label maps to a provider/model/base_url that a Hermes-routed agent can run on.

agent_models.description: Maps an agent name (or the literal 'default') to a label defined in hermes_models. Hermes-routed agents not listed fall back to 'default', then the single SHANNON_HERMES_* env target.

description.description: Description of the target environment, its deployment context, and any information that helps guide the security assessment

type.description: Type of rule (what aspect of requests or source code to match against)
